---
title: "Quiz · Cross-Mesh Communication"
---

A short knowledge check. Answers are hidden behind callouts so you can
self-grade after answering.

## 1. What does a Pico use to initiate a subscription with an unknown Pico?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
The recipient's **did:webvh**. The initiator resolves the identity, performs
an introduction handshake, and creates peer DIDs.
:::

## 2. When a relationship is established, what identifier do events and queries use?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
The pairwise **did:peer** relationship, not the public did:webvh.
:::

## 3. What protocol provides encrypted communication across meshes?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
**DIDComm**, using the peer relationship.
:::

## 4. When does a Pico relationship use an ECI rather than a DID?

::: {.callout-tip collapse="true" title="Show answer"}
For **family relationships** — parent and child Picos communicating over
their family channels. A DID-based introduction would be unnecessary
overhead for relationships already established structurally within a Pico
family.
:::
